in_marathi.name: Girishbhai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girishbhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girishbhai is a Hindu name that means 'Lord of the Mountain'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', which means mountain, and 'Bhai', which means brother or lord. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to signify strength, courage, and protection. It is also associated with the Hindu god Ganesha, who is known as the lord of the mountains and the remover of obstacles.
